Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

#SevDefect / locationEvidence, mechanism, fix
1MEDAerodrome is bunched at the chicane, not along the Mistral
scenery/paul_ricard.js:323-328, 340-347, 363, 389		Apron (86x240 m), runway and taxiway patches are centred on K(0.50) and hangars sit at 0.50±42 m, but the brief puts hangars at 0.40-0.45 and the run-off-parallel runway along the straight. Apron spans ≈0.479-0.521: light plane 1 (0.465, :389) parks ≈80 m off it, the tower (0.545, :363) stands past its end. The lane/taxiway dashes (:329-336) run 0.40-0.60 (≈1.16 km) over 280-300 m patches, so dashes lie on bare ground. Frame 38 shows hangars as three plain grey gabled boxes with the barrel roofs not readable. Fix: span the runway/apron patches 0.40-0.55 as several drapeRun segments, or restrict dashes to the patch length; move plane 1 to ≥0.48.
2MED"Continuous" abrasive run-off is not continuous; plates read as stepped, tiled lilac
scenery/paul_ricard.js:66-80		Every 15 m drape tile alternates BLUE/BLUE_D and RED/RED_D by index (i&1), and tiles are separate slabs 0.10-0.16 m thick. In frames 03/04/38 green terrain shows between plates, plate edges stair-step with visible vertical faces on the Red Zone, and the Blue Zone renders pale lilac/lavender rather than blue. Fix: overlap seg by more than 5 %, drop the per-tile alternation (or alternate by 3+ tiles), lower thickness, or raise blue saturation under TLX tone mapping.
3MEDPlateau reads olive-green grass, not bleached limestone
js/circuits/paul_ricard.js:56 (pal.grass), brief §2		pal.grass = [0.34,0.40,0.21] fills every infield gap and the whole horizon band (all day frames), the opposite of the brief's bleached/pale plateau; sparse scrub is also not visible. Fix: paler grass [~0.55,0.52,0.40] or a limestone terrain tint, tested with terrainOuter 130.
4LOWDay sky is a flat saturated blue with no horizon haze (dry/overcast)
js/circuits/paul_ricard.js:50-52 vs js/lighting/atmosphere.js:444-456		pal.horizon [0.84,0.82,0.74] never shows: dry frames go from saturated blue straight to the ridge silhouettes. Overcast (frame 22) still shows the full blue sky: atmosphere.js:454 flattens the horizon only when raceTimeOfDay === 'default', and these frames were captured with explicit --tod day, so this is probably a capture artefact and not a game defect (not re-captured with default tod).
5LOWHorizon ridge ring reads as gabled tents
scenery/paul_ricard.js:308-321		ridge() boxes in three rings (120+ m long, 12-54 m high) show as triangular-faceted blocks in every frame; at night they become pale grey silhouettes. The brief wants a pale, sparsely pined massif. Fix: lower hVar, add taper/noise, tint by distance.
6LOWNo night lighting by design: pit straight is near-black
js/circuits/paul_ricard.js:22 (night:false), furniture.lamp 'none'		Night frames 55-66: only car headlights and a few pit lamps light the ground; the main grandstand and paddock are dark, wet frames add only puddle glare. Expected for a non-night circuit (survey-track), but a night race here is unlit apart from the car. Not a fix unless night:true is wanted (the real circuit ran a 24h).
7LOWBrief elevation fracs are source-frac, built profile differs
js/circuits/paul_ricard.js:58-62 vs docs/tracks/paul_ricard.md §3		def elevations s=0.30/+3, 0.66/-3.5, 0.88/+2.5 are source-control fracs on a reversed def. Measured built profile: +3.1 m at racing 0.70 (Signes), −3.6 m at 0.35 (Mistral), +2.5 m at 0.10-0.12 (Verrerie), range −3.6…+3.1 m. The doc reads them as racing positions. Fix the doc; geometry itself is sensible.
8INFOMain grandstand 148 m is unsourced
scenery/paul_ricard.js:187-216		4,400 seats is stated; length is an estimate (brief 'uncertain' list). Also 3 dead duplicate bay models at 0.95/0.97/0.99/0.01 are superseded by the engine pit complex by design (:116-124).
9INFOGround audit residue within baseline
audit-circuit ground		buried 2, unsupported 5, flatCoplanar 10, plus verify-track 'suppressed bush=2'. Positions not localised in this read-only pass.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Not captured: dawn, eye/trackside in weather and at dusk/night, dusk/night for wet/fog/storm/overcast, a second renderer (GLX/WGX), aerial survey-track grid, phone viewport, any HUD.
